description: This file contains utility functions for fuzzy searching and scoring nodes based on search relevance, including a fuzzyScore function, a searchNodes function, and a debounce utility.

methods.name: fuzzyScore
methods.description: Calculates a fuzzy search score between a search term and a target text, with higher scores indicating better matches.

methods.name: searchNodes
methods.description: Scores and sorts nodes by their relevance to a search value using fuzzy matching.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a function that delays its execution until after a specified wait time.
